meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Worldwide FM: Discord button and membership appeals, plus show artwork and footer controls
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13: rendered DOM of www.worldwidefm.net home (iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, which serve the same responsive Next.js page), logged out, captured with headless Chrome; counts were taken on the saved DOM. Fixtures real.html and desktop-real.html are structural captures with text stripped; `data-keep` marks the live player toggle, the live label link, the main content and the logo link.

The site uses Tailwind utility classes (unusable), so rules use hrefs and element position: `body > a[href*="discord.gg"]` 1 (the other two Discord links are in the header and footer and are left alone), `main a[href="/membership"]` 1 (Learn More) and `footer a[href="/membership"]` 1 (JOIN NOW), `a[href^="/episode/"] img` 81 (cards on Home; the pictures are lazy placeholders in the capture), `footer` 1.

The live player (`data-testid=live-player-toggle`) and the episode and show cards are never hidden; only their pictures can be blurred or hidden. The original generic rules matched nothing and are kept. NOT verified: show, episode and video pages, the persistent audio player, the membership page, logged-in state.
